patch_description:
This implementation replaces unrestricted 18-dimensional point mutation with a symmetry-reduced differential-evolution search over a structured 3-fold rotational family. The configuration consists of a center point, two optimized interior 3-point rotational orbits, and two fixed outer rotational orbits forming a regular hexagonal hull.

The regular hexagon guarantees a known convex hull and avoids the restrictive corner-triangle bottlenecks imposed by a square. Only four continuous parameters are optimized: two orbit radii and two orbit phases. This substantially reduces the search space while retaining non-grid, non-collinear configurations. A deterministic population search is followed by coordinate-pattern polishing on the actual minimum-area objective. Finally, the construction is scaled so its hexagonal convex hull has unit area.
